qualification.note: Baseline spread/total model. Spread = Elo expected margin. Total = league average. Will improve as Polymarket snapshots accumulate.

_retirement_reason: Fundamentally broken — this model predicted moneyline outcomes (who wins), not spread outcomes (who covers). It used baseline_heuristic with coefficients [1.0] on elo_margin, never conditioning on the spread line. The spread sub-model achieved only 32.9% hit rate on 340 calls (-126.2 units), consistent with a moneyline model being scored against spread outcomes. Replaced by wnba-spread-margin-v1.json which uses BasketballModel's normal CDF approach: P(away_cover) = normal_cdf(spread_away_line, expected_margin, margin_sd=10.5). The total sub-model (78.3% hit rate on 387 calls, +191.5 units) was always separate — total_research_artifact in model.yaml was incorrectly pointing here instead of wnba-total-score-ridge-v1.json, fixed simultaneously.
